oracle.comparison: All integer PCM and serialized state/control fields are compared exactly.
coverage: Zero and nonzero excitation/LPC/pitch history, all three signal classes, gain changes and NLSF interpolation
Initial loss, up to six consecutive lost frames, voiced-to-unvoiced recovery and CNG accumulation
Both CNG gain arithmetic branches, clipped PCM and LPC saturation, zero-energy recovery and sample-rate changes
oracle.implementation: Pinned original Opus 1.3.1 C functions, scalar arch=0; original static library plus a state serialization shim used only in ignored authoring cache. No compiled code is shipped or loaded at runtime or by public tests.
oracle.public_tests: standalone.tests.test_opus_silk_synthesis: three methods, all exact golden comparisons pass under -I -S on both Python versions.

pending: Complete Opus public decode/encode, stereo, packet/FEC/hybrid integration and resampling are tracked by the owning Opus port, not claimed by this DSP component.
scope: Qualified pure Python Opus SILK Q14 synthesis, voiced/unvoiced packet-loss concealment, comfort noise, saturating LPC analysis, recovery glue, and native-compatible initialization. This component does not parse complete Opus packets or encode audio.
shared_arithmetic: Explicit signed 16/32-bit width, rounding, saturating shifts and reciprocal helpers from silk_fixed; 16-bit bwexpander and identical sqrt_approx from the legacy SILK port. Energy, main synthesis, PLC and CNG follow Opus sources independently, preserving their version-specific differences.
